title: Ashley St. Clair Was Offered Millions for Her Silence on Elon Musk. She Spoke Out Instead.
summary: In the documentary “Musk,” Ashley St. Clair, a former right-wing influencer and mother of one of Musk’s children, speaks about her relationship with him.
